Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (V-n and gust envelope construction). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: V-n and gust envelope construction and Flutter and divergence boundary mapping. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Aeroelasticity simulation engine) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
